verdict.rationale: A programmatic API is a fair question for an authenticator app, but the evidence shows no documented public API for driving Google Authenticator. The docs cover only manual in-app actions such as swiping, QR transfer and account sync. The open-source HOTP/TOTP implementations and the PAM module are developer building blocks, not an API that drives the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
